label: Genetic algorithm
definition: A metaheuristic search algorithm inspired by natural selection that evolves a population of candidate solutions by selection, crossover and mutation.
comment: It is used to tune model parameters and to size or site energy systems.

label: Cuckoo search
definition: A metaheuristic algorithm inspired by the brood parasitism of cuckoos, combining Lévy-flight random walks with replacement of poor solutions.
comment: It is used to estimate distribution parameters and to tune machine-learning models.

label: Nelder-Mead method
definition: A derivative-free optimization method that moves a simplex of points through the search space by reflection, expansion and contraction.
comment: It is commonly used to maximize likelihood functions when fitting distributions.

label: Aquila optimizer
definition: A metaheuristic algorithm inspired by the hunting behaviour of the Aquila eagle.
comment: It is used to tune hyperparameters of machine-learning models such as support vector regression and XGBoost.

label: Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm
definition: An iterative algorithm for nonlinear least-squares problems that blends gradient descent and the Gauss-Newton method.
comment: It is widely used to train neural networks and to fit nonlinear curves.

label: Generalized reduced gradient method
definition: A gradient-based algorithm for nonlinear constrained optimization that reduces the problem to the space of independent variables.
comment: It is the nonlinear solver of the Microsoft Excel Solver, often used to fit distribution parameters.

label: Bat algorithm
definition: A metaheuristic algorithm inspired by the echolocation behaviour of bats.
comment: It is used for parameter estimation and multi-objective optimization.

label: Chaotic particle swarm optimization
definition: A variant of particle swarm optimization that uses chaotic maps to diversify the search and avoid premature convergence.
comment: It is used to tune model parameters where standard particle swarm optimization stagnates.

label: Grey wolf optimizer
definition: A metaheuristic algorithm inspired by the leadership hierarchy and hunting strategy of grey wolves.
comment: It is used to tune machine-learning models for renewable energy forecasting.

label: Particle swarm optimization
definition: A metaheuristic algorithm in which a swarm of candidate solutions moves through the search space guided by the best positions found by each particle and by the swarm.
comment: It is widely used to tune model parameters and to size hybrid energy systems.

label: Gradient descent with adaptive learning rate
definition: A training algorithm for neural networks that updates weights along the negative gradient with a learning rate adapted during training.
comment: Adapting the learning rate speeds up convergence compared with fixed-rate gradient descent.

label: Lagrange multiplier method
definition: A method for finding extrema of a function subject to equality constraints by introducing Lagrange multipliers.
comment: It is used, for example, to derive maximum entropy distributions under moment constraints.

label: Newton-Raphson method
definition: An iterative root-finding method that uses the derivative of a function to refine successive approximations.
comment: It is used to solve the maximum likelihood equations of the Weibull distribution.

label: Conjugate gradient method
definition: An iterative optimization method that searches along mutually conjugate directions.
comment: It is used to train neural networks and to solve large systems of equations.
